actual_replica_evidence: Native Mongo diagnostic reads use a fresh owned PID namespace on the fixed loopback PRIMARY replica.
Seeded malformed fields and synthetic sensitive strings are removed by server-side scalar projections; output contains none of the seeded strings.
26 attempts yield 25 returned rows, explicit truncation, and the canonical run_id association.
Mongo command monitoring during inspect/trace observed only the read allowlist, with unchanged collection inventory.
Cleanup rechecks exact PID namespace and primary/member identity before dropping only the owned fixture database.
Existing recovery harness ran with synthetic workbook calls and real Mongo transactions/indexes under the scrubbed CLI child environment.
injected_or_pure_evidence: Wrong URI/host/database, standalone/secondary, wrong set name and remote/malformed advertised members are rejected by the shared identity guard.
Privilege errors 13 and 18 are injected unit cases, not a real authenticated Mongo read-only-user rehearsal.
Injected failure on the attempt read after a successful job read rejects the trace; it cannot become an empty healthy result.
Unknown/repeated flags, production test targets and malformed/oversized/injection-shaped job IDs are rejected before database access.
A real subprocess confirms removal of inherited provider credentials, future unknown secrets, Node options, Atlas target and dotenv path. HOME and USERPROFILE are forced to the OS null device.
Help, discovery and runbook references work without credentials or a live database. Package test/lint registration and executable runbook examples are checked.
corrected_attempts: The first hostile-environment test failed because Windows restored USERPROFILE when omitted. The helper now explicitly forces HOME/USERPROFILE to NUL (or /dev/null on Unix), and the actual subprocess test passes.
Node test output format is explicitly TAP in the fast child, so pass/skip parsing does not depend on terminal reporter selection.
limitations: Production diagnostics and every repair/apply command are deliberately unsupported; no generic Mongo interface is exposed.
Inspect samples newest jobs by _id, at most 25; it does not count all statuses or certify queue health.
Trace returns at most 25 attempts and 25 referenced runs. Runs/attempts have 90-day TTL; no archive or provider membership is queried.
Separate read operations are not a transactionally consistent snapshot. Each query has maxTimeMS 2000, no disk spill, and a 26-row lookahead.
Startup-level shell NODE_OPTIONS can run before JavaScript starts; only child startup options can be scrubbed by this code.
Failure output from the scrubbed synthetic test child is retained only in a unique bounded local temporary log, never emitted into JSON or uploaded. The local log is intentionally operator-removable.
Windows proof does not substitute for the separately recorded Linux/container and fresh-agent rehearsal.
